title: jmap_handler swallows mutex poison silently (no log unlike session_handler)
description: lib.rs:141-144: jmap_handler's store.lock() Err branch returns s-0-s-0-s-0 with no log. session_handler (lib.rs:107-110) logs tracing::error\! for the same condition. A poisoned mutex means an earlier request panicked while holding the lock — this should be logged at error level. The inconsistency means the first symptom visible in logs would be from session_handler, not jmap_handler, even though all JMAP calls go through jmap_handler.
